verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's MCP server is explicitly docs-only: it reads public documentation and the OpenAPI spec and 'never proxies calls to the API'. AI assistants can therefore help developers write integration code, but cannot operate Kintsugi itself through natural-language commands. No natural-language command interface for the product is documented, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
